lead.headline: 25 senior and disabled housing nonprofits on HUD money kept filing federal audits years after the IRS revoked their exemption
lead.number: 25 groups, about $83M counting each group's biggest single year (not the $940M first claimed); 5 name-match active HUD Section 202 rent contracts in the same town.
lead.watch_out: The dollars are mostly an old HUD capital advance carried on the books every year, not new spending, and the HUD match is on property name and place only.
